messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: Amrix extended-release capsules are not recommended.
Blood levels run about 40% higher.
Amrix stays in the body much longer.
The half-life is 50 hours versus 32 hours in younger adults.

Tonmya is limited to the lower 2.8 mg dose once daily at bedtime.

Pregnancy:
Pregnancy guidance differs by product.
Check which cyclobenzaprine product you use.
Tonmya is associated with fibromyalgia.
Animal data suggests Tonmya may increase the risk of neural tube defects.
This risk occurs when Tonmya is used two weeks before conception and through the first trimester.
Neural tube development happens early.
This often occurs before pregnancy is recognized.
Avoid Tonmya during this window.
Your healthcare provider should do a pregnancy test before you start Tonmya.
You should use effective contraception during treatment and for two weeks after the final dose.
3
Immediate-release tablets and Amrix (muscle spasm) are available.
Data have not identified a risk of major birth defects.
Data have not identified a risk of miscarriage.
Animal studies at usual doses did not show harm to the fetus.
Triples: [["Amrix", "has administration instruction", "not recommended"], ["Amrix", "has pharmacokinetic property", "blood levels run about 40% higher"], ["Amrix", "has pharmacokinetic property", "stays in the body much longer"], ["Amrix", "has half life", "50 hours"], ["Amrix", "has half life comparison", "32 hours in younger adults"], ["Tonmya", "has dosage restriction", "limited to the lower 2.8 mg dose once daily at bedtime"], ["Tonmya", "associated with", "fibromyalgia"], ["Tonmya", "may increase risk of", "neural tube defects"], ["Tonmya", "has risk window", "used two weeks before conception and through the first trimester"], ["Tonmya", "has administration instruction", "avoid during this window"], ["Tonmya", "requires pregnancy test before starting", "healthcare provider"], ["Tonmya", "requires contraception use during", "treatment and for two weeks after final dose"], ["Immediate-release tablets", "available for", "muscle spasm"], ["Cyclobenzaprine", "has pregnancy guidance", "differs by product"], ["Cyclobenzaprine", "has administration instruction", "check which product you use"], ["Cyclobenzaprine", "has no identified risk of", "major birth defects"], ["Cyclobenzaprine", "has no identified risk of", "miscarriage"], ["Cyclobenzaprine", "has no fetal harm in", "animal studies at usual doses"]]
Relations: ["associated with", "available for", "has administration instruction", "has dosage restriction", "has half life", "has half life comparison", "has no fetal harm in", "has no identified risk of", "has pharmacokinetic property", "has pregnancy guidance", "has risk window", "may increase risk of", "requires contraception use during", "requires pregnancy test before starting"]
Answer:

completion:
associated with: The subject drug is linked to or commonly used in the treatment of the medical condition specified by the object entity.  
available for: The subject drug is indicated or approved for the medical condition or purpose specified by the object entity.  
has administration instruction: The subject drug has a specific instruction or recommendation for its use, as specified by the object entity.  
has dosage restriction: The subject drug has a specific limitation on its dosage, as specified by the object entity.  
has half life: The subject drug has a specific duration of time for its half-life, as specified by the object entity.  
has half life comparison: The subject drug has a specific comparison of its half-life relative to another group or condition, as specified by the object entity.  
has no fetal harm in: The subject drug has been shown to not cause harm to the fetus in the specified studies or conditions.  
has no identified risk of: The subject drug has no identified risk of the adverse outcome or event specified by the object entity.  
has pharmacokinetic property: The subject drug has a specific pharmacokinetic characteristic, as described by the object entity.  
has pregnancy guidance: The subject drug has specific guidance or recommendations related to pregnancy, as specified by the object entity.  
has risk window: The subject drug has a specific time window during which its use may pose a risk, as specified by the object entity.  
may increase risk of: The subject drug may increase the risk of the adverse outcome or event specified by the object entity.  
requires contraception use during: The subject drug requires the use of effective contraception during the time period specified by the object entity.  
requires pregnancy test before starting: The subject drug requires a pregnancy test to be conducted by the specified entity before initiating treatment.
